items.title: 新增 ERC：零知识 Agent 支付验证
items.note: （jqhc）提交，ERC-8150 讨论帖 13:51：受 ERC-8004 启发，用户为 Agent 的一批交易签名，Agent 必须提交 ZK 证明其交易与用户签名意图一致，验证通过后资金才会转出。
items.title_en: Add ERC: Zero-Knowledge Agent Payment Verification
items.note_en: (jqhc), submitted, with the ERC-8150 thread, 13:51: inspired by ERC-8004, users sign off on an agent's batch, and the agent must submit a ZK proof that its transactions match the signed intent before any funds move.

summary_en: Thegaram submitted skipping the EIP-3607 check for EIP-8141 frame transactions. nerolation's EIP adding authorization data to the EIP-7623 floor merged, so EIP-7702 authorization lists now count toward the calldata floor. kevaundray's Block-in-Blobs EIP merged. The EF launched the Trillion Dollar Security dashboard. jqhc submitted a ZK agent payment verification ERC where agents must prove transactions match the user's signed intent before funds move.
